name: VO615A
title: VO615A family: high-temperature phototransistor optocoupler, 5000 VAC, DIP-4 and SMD-4
summary: A single-channel optocoupler: a GaAs infrared LED driving a silicon NPN phototransistor, collector and emitter only, in a four-lead package. It runs from -55 °C to +110 °C. Ten CTR grades cover 50 % to 600 % (VO615A) down to narrow bins -1 to -9. Isolation is 5000 VAC for one minute, VIORM 850 Vpeak, with DIP-4, wide DIP-4 and three surface-mount lead forms, each with or without VDE approval.

circuits.title: Switching test circuit
circuits.description: The LED is driven by an input pulse between its two terminals. The phototransistor works as a common-emitter stage: its emitter is grounded and its collector is pulled up to VCC = 5 V through the load resistor RL, and the collector is the output VOUT. Rise, fall, turn-on and turn-off times are taken on VOUT at its 10 % and 90 % levels.

operation.text: A GaAs infrared LED faces a silicon NPN phototransistor inside a four-pin plastic DIP. Only the transistor collector and emitter are brought out; there is no base pin. The part is rated for ambient temperatures from -55 °C to +110 °C.

VO615A without a suffix spans 50 % to 600 % at IF = 5 mA. Bins -1 to -4 are graded at IF = 10 mA (40-80 %, 63-125 %, 100-200 %, 160-320 %) and also carry a minimum at IF = 1 mA. Bins -5 to -9 are graded at IF = 5 mA (50-150 %, 100-300 %, 80-160 %, 130-260 %, 200-400 %). All at VCE = 5 V, 25 °C.

Reinforced isolation for safety class II protective separation: insulation application classes I to IV at mains up to 300 V, and up to 600 V under table 1 of IEC 60664-1. Listed uses include switch-mode power supplies, line receivers, computer peripheral interfaces and microprocessor system interfaces. Ratings: VIOTM = 6 kVpeak, VIOWM = 600 VRMS, VIORM = 850 Vpeak, partial discharge test voltage Vpd = 1.6 kV.

BSI, FIMKO, UL 1577, cUL 1577 and CQC for every part; DIN EN 60747-5-5 (VDE 0884-5) for the option 1 versions (order codes X001, X016, X017T, X018T, X019T). VO615A is the model number under which all versions appear in agency files.
The output safety power PSO is 265 mW and the input safety current ISI 130 mA up to 25 °C; both fall linearly to zero at the safety temperature of 150 °C.

In the sample test pulse (DIN EN 60747-5-2 / IEC 60747-5-5) the voltage rises to VIOTM in t1, holds for tTr = 60 s, falls to Vpd in t2 and is held for tstres = 12 s, inside which the measurement window ttest = 10 s sits between t3 and t4. t1 and t2 are 1 s to 10 s; t3 and t4 are 1 s.

The output is the collector of the test circuit, so it falls when the LED turns on. Rise and fall times, ton and toff are taken at the 10 % and 90 % levels of the output swing, with ton and toff counted from the input pulse edges.
Example VO615A-3X017T: first line VO615A-3, then the VDE mark, then V YWW 24. The marking shows only options 1, 7 and 8; only option 1 parts carry the VDE mark; the T for tape and reel is not marked.
